admission.justification: The scheduler carries the disconnect wait and the cache carries the admission check, and the cancellation cases prove child reaping, no admission and mid-finish withdrawal.

applicability: Change-set HTTP reads served by the family's bounded scheduler.
conditions: A queued abandoned job is withdrawn before it runs; a running job keeps its admission slot until its worker physically ends.
The read's cancellation event reaches the Git runner, which kills the child and its process group through its one kill owner.
The cache checks the event before, during and after finish and withdraws any value it already admitted on an abandoned read.
exclusions: A completed response, a non-change-set route, and a client-side abort without a server read.
statement: A change-set read whose client disconnected stops its queued or running work and admits no abandoned result.
